Package com.salesforce.multicloudj.kms.client

Class KmsClient

java.lang.Object
com.salesforce.multicloudj.kms.client.KmsClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public class KmsClient extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Entry point for client code to manage keys in a cloud key management service in a substrate-agnostic way.

Usage example: 

 KmsClient client = KmsClient.builder(providerId)
     .withRegion(region)
     .withKeyContainer(keyContainer)
     .build();

 CreateKeyResponse created = client.createKey(CreateKeyRequest.builder()
     .keyName("orders-root-key")
     .description("Root key for order data")
     .build());
 client.tagKey(created.getKeyRef(), Map.of("team", "orders"));
